title: 10.28.2018 Nightly Wear OS Null Null Complication problem
symptom: After updating to the 10.28.2018 nightly, the xDrip+ complication on Wear OS watch faces shows 'null null' instead of the correct data. The issue occurs on both Ticwatch Pro and Ticwatch E watches. The xDrip+ watch faces themselves sync and work correctly.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a root cause. The user initially suspected the 10.28.2018 Wear OS app, but a maintainer stated nothing changed in the wear component between 23rd and 28th Oct. Later, the user found that adding a calibration fixes the issue, implying the cause may be related to missing calibration data, but this is not explicitly stated as a root cause.
fix: Add a single calibration on the phone app. This resolved the null null complication issue for the original reporter. For a later user with a similar issue, adding a calibration only worked temporarily, and they reported the issue recurring after a few minutes.
evidence_quote: The SIMPLE FIX is to ADD a single CALIBRATION (the same reasoning as starting a new sensor where you are forced to add 2 calibrations).
